quest.title: The Path of Papers
quest.description: You see an anxious person near the Akademiya...\n
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Alrani, where did you go...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alrani?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon remembers the name... The young lady who's always writing her thesis? The one we met at Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, she said she left Akademiya for some materials. She should have been back now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the woman there seems really nervous... let's go ask her about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Alrani did return to the Akademiya, we might as well stop by and say hello.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Greetings. About Alrani...

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Are you the Adventurers sent by the Adventurers' Guild!? Did you find Alrani?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: I know I've been pressing and I'm sorry for that. But she really worries me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, take it easy. We are not from the Adventurers' Guild. Just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: You are not Adventurers? I'm so sorry. I haven't got any news from them. I'm so worried...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell the story of what you've been through with Alrani...

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: So you are the Traveler Alrani keeps talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: I'm Niloofar, researcher at the Akademiya... You could tell, right?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Be that as I am, I now devote most of my energy to teaching students on research.

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Alrani is my student. She's been struggling with her thesis...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are... her mentor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miss Alrani said she had to rewrite many of her papers because they were disapproved by her mentor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, this isn't the time for this. What happened to Miss Alrani?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: She... went missing...

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Alrani came back all excited from Inazuma with a paper a while ago, which was about the folk culture of Watatsumi Island...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I could tell. That paper is well written, and of a high standard in every respect...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: But... she submitted the paper too late! I asked her to send me the first draft in advance, but I never heard back.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: By the time she came back with the full version of her paper, someone had submitted one with exactly the same topic, which had already passed the preliminary review!

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I tried in every way to get her to pass the review, but she still didn't make it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why's that? Miss Alrani started forming ideas for her papers long ago. How come it took so long...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... Inazuma...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Sakoku Decree!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I've no idea how to break the news to her... I was going to think of a gentler way to let her know.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Then a motor mouth out of nowhere just spilled it all to her.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Then she went missing. I turned every stone in the Akademiya, and she was nowhere to be found. So I went to the Adventurers' Guild and put out a commission.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: They found nothing but Alrani's notebook at a place, and there was no sign of her.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: The Adventurers should still be searching for her everywhere...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I... I don't know what to do... *sob*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We'll start from where they found the notebook!

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Really? I can't thank you enough!

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I'll mark the location of the notebook on the map for you.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Oh, and your payment...

choices.text: We can talk about that later.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Thank you very much. I'll be waiting here for news from the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Please be safe, Alrani...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll help look for Miss Alrani!

choices.text: She'd been working hard on it.

dialogues.speaker: Gobley
dialogues.text: Please, have mercy! This is all just a big misunderstanding!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What have you done to Miss Alrani? Spill!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or... Or we will kick your butt!

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: No, no, please... Please listen to me. You got it all wrong...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: We wouldn't dare mess with her. We are no match for her!

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: It's a long story...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: We happened to be short of money some time ago, so we and our big sis were expecting to fill our wallet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft, you mean stealing and robbing again.

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Well... We are Treasure Hoarders... That's kinda what we do...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: As we were making plans in the camp, we saw a young lady carrying a huge bag coming towards the camp.

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Seemed to us she'd lost her soul. Freaked us all out.

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Before we got ready to make our move on her, she just plopped down beside the campfire, weeping and throwing a bunch of books into the fire...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: That was really spooky...

choices.text: Freaked out by a young lady...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Sure we are, but it's not like we kill people. We just pick and steal...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: She got us more puzzled before we even realized what was going on. She threw a bag of Mora and asked us to lock her up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh... Eh...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: No one would dare touch her at first... But she wouldn't eat or drink and just kept asking us to lock her up.

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: At last, big sis asked us to make a cage with branches and let her in.

choices.text: That was nice of your big sis...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Well, big sis always has respect for learned folks. She says she'd want to go to school one day...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: Ahem... The lady's over there, see her yourself if you don't believe me. Big sis must be soothing her now...

response.speaker: Gobley
response.text: If you can take the lady out of here, we'd be more than willing to repay you!

choices.text: You were actually being nice to her...
So did you do what she asked?
So you do have Alrani with you.
What have you done to Alrani?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tell us what you know! Or... Or we'll kick your butt!

dialogues.text: Alrani! Are you gonna come out of the cage or what!?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: No! No researcher, no academy anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: I've paid you for this. Can't you leave me be!?
You're stubborn, annoyingly stubborn...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He—Hello there...
Hmm? Oh, you are...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Tr—Traveler! *sob*...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Alrani, you really are here...

choices.text: It's good to see that you're alright.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: *sob*... I wrote on the subject first! It's not fair!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: If I hadn't stayed in Inazuma for too long, my paper would have passed...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Calm now... Do you still want to finish your paper?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: *panting*

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I... I quit! Papers, Akademiya... I'm done with all of it! Only fools write papers! Akademiya can do whatever they want!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I paid Narzam to protect me. No one's gonna force me to work on that paper!
Hmph...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You are...?

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: I'm Narzam. What I do... Hmph, you must've known it. I'll cut to the chase.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: I know you, Traveler. You've been active around here lately.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: If you've got a commission to bring the girl back, you can give it a go. I won't stop you.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Hey! I've paid you!

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: For what? It's not even enough to pay for our food for a few more days.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I won't go back anyway. It's just new subjects and field research there. I'll have restless days and nights...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I might even get caught by some weird people, or run into peculiar monsters. Then there would be no time for me to finish my paper and I'd miss the paper defense... again.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: *sob*... No... I'd rather be locked up here. *sob*

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Traveler, please send a message to Ms. Niloofar for me. I'll write you a note. I don't want to go back, please...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Alrani writes down the note while weeping...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: There you go. *sob*... Why would anyone invent papers? *sob*...

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Okay... Calm down. No one is taking you away for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miss Alrani... She seems very unstable right now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's leave her here while we take this note back to Niloofar.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: No need to worry if we will hurt her. It's like what she said, she's paid me.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Besides... Hmph, I finally found someone who is educated. She'd be very useful here.

choices.text: Niloofar told us about your paper.

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Traveler! Did you find Alrani?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, but...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Niloofar what happened and hand her the note...

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Narzam? How...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know her?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Not personally. I heard someone mention her as some weird Treasure Hoarder.

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: They say she would ask her victims a question when she plunders them.

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Literature, Elements, all sorts of stuff. Even brain teasers.

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: If you solve her problem, she will give back everything she looted, plus escorting you back to the city.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So she's a weirdo...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: No one knows. I know this because my mentor once met her in the wild.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Her question was: "What quickly fills an empty room?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's wind! Is Paimon right? It must be wind!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ugh... Candle light?

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: My mentor answered, "Elements are everywhere."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's cheating!

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Haha. Anyway, Narzam escorted my mentor back to the city and they practically had a goodbye in decorum.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: I wouldn't be so worried if Alrani is with her.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: But she can't stay there forever. I have to figure out a way to help her with her paper...

choices.text: What exactly is she up to?

dialogues.speaker: Niloofar
dialogues.text: Please be safe, Alrani...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: She was quite a diligent kid. Though she always chased weird dead ends...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: She is more than qualified as a student, and I believe she will be so as a researcher.

choices.text: Is it hard for students to get their papers passed at Akademiya?

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: To be honest, yes.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Paper review is complicated. You have to take into account your research focus, how extensive the references are...

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: Also you should keep in mind any overlap or conflict between others' papers and your own. After your thesis proposal is submitted, you'll still bump into all kinds of difficulties.

response.speaker: Niloofar
response.text: *sigh* But I have to say, she's exceptionally unlucky...

dialogues.speaker: Narzam
dialogues.text: Anything else?

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: "Good" to Alrani?

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Don't get me wrong. I do this for three simple reasons. First, Alrani has paid me for staying here.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Second, I take only money, not lives. I'd ruin my reputation if I ditched her into the wild.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Third, she's a learned lady who has a bright future.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Being able to help her a little bit would give some credit to us Treasure Hoarders I guess? Hmph...

choices.text: How much did she pay you?

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: No small amount. She said she earned that by making some "fertilizers." Don't know what's that. Don't care.

response.speaker: Narzam
response.text: Anyways, she paid us, and we'll help her for now. That's it.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: *sob*... Why would anyone invent papers? *sob*...
